# CLI: Monitor

## get-check-alarm

Kind: Read.

Reads the current alarm and its location states through the check's
HistoryAlarmID. An empty alarm reference is NotFound (exit 4). An unknown
definition can return server error 500 (exit 1). A check's Status reports
whether it runs. MonitorStatus reports its alarm state.

| Flag         | Type     | Required |
| ------------ | -------- | -------- |
| `--check-id` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode monitor get-check-alarm --check-id <check-id> --query Alarm
```

## get-dashboard

Kind: Read.

Reads one dashboard without widgets. There is no delete command.

| Flag             | Type     | Required |
| ---------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--dashboard-id` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode monitor get-dashboard --dashboard-id <dashboard-id> --query Dashboard
```

## get-notification-quota

Kind: Read.

--kind accepts Email or SMS, case insensitively. Reads quota identity, status,
expiry, and AutoRenew. Table and text timestamps show UTC. A missing quota is
NotFound (exit 4).

| Flag     | Type     | Required |
| -------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--kind` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode monitor get-notification-quota --kind Email --query Quota
```

## get-notification-quota-usage

Kind: Read.

--kind accepts Email, case insensitively. Reads message consumption and
descriptions. A missing quota is NotFound (exit 4). SMS usage is refused before
requests.

| Flag     | Type     | Required |
| -------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--kind` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode monitor get-notification-quota-usage --kind Email --query Usage
```

## list-check-response-times

Kind: Read.

HTTP checks only. --start and --end are RFC 3339. --end defaults to now and
--start to 24 hours before --end. The window is at most 24 hours. Values are
average response times in milliseconds per probe location, in 5-minute buckets
for a 24-hour window. Use get-check-alarm for location names.

| Flag         | Type     | Required |
| ------------ | -------- | -------- |
| `--check-id` | `string` | yes      |
| `--start`    | `string` |          |
| `--end`      | `string` |          |

```sh
greennode monitor list-check-response-times --check-id <check-id>
```

## list-dashboards

Kind: Read.

Lists custom dashboards by default. --system lists dashboards GreenNode
generates per resource. The read omits widgets. There is no delete command.

| Flag       | Type   | Required |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- |
| `--page`   | `int`  |          |
| `--size`   | `int`  |          |
| `--system` | `bool` |          |

```sh
greennode monitor list-dashboards
```

## list-synthetic-packages

Kind: Read.

Lists class options, class unit packages, and v1 packages separately, with their
own identifiers. Class Packages shows unit API, location, tier, and monthly unit
price. Options join only by exact package ID within the class. The v1 catalog
cannot establish class option prices. Disabled classes stay visible.
AutoRenewEligible is unknown without provider evidence. Settings periods are
shown separately. Known free periods are capped by the free maximum. Read-only
settings allow this read.

No fields.

```sh
greennode monitor list-synthetic-packages
```

## quota-status

Kind: Read.

--kind optionally selects synthetic, email, or sms, case insensitively. Omitted
means all three. Returns a sequential snapshot with one UTC AsOf. Synthetic uses
quota, detail, class catalog, and settings reads, with detail price and class
and an unknown package name. Notification price is the current list price.
Missing quotas produce none rows and exit 0. Failed rows print partial output,
ignore --query, and exit 1 as QuotaStatusIncomplete. Null means unknown. False
and zero remain distinct. RenewWindowOpen describes the catalog-eligible free
Synthetic timing window. NextSafeCommand suggests renewal inside the free window
or recovery for expired free trash, only with POC and auto-renew off. Suggested
writes require explicit guards from a fresh read. Table and text show time left
in days, hours, and minutes. Rows without errors have a blank Error cell.
Read-only settings allow this read.

| Flag     | Type     | Required |
| -------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--kind` | `string` |          |

```sh
greennode monitor quota-status --kind synthetic
```

## quote-create-notification-quota

Kind: Read.

Estimates one month of Email or SMS capacity without ordering. Omitting
--package-id selects the unique zero-price package. An existing quota is
refused. MaxPrice and NoWait are ignored. Prices are in VND. Email pre-VAT
treatment is inferred and SMS VAT treatment is unverified. GuardPrice is the
higher of list and quote prices.

| Flag                                     | Type      | Required |
| ---------------------------------------- | --------- | -------- |
| `--kind`                                 | `string`  | yes      |
| `--package-id`                           | `string`  |          |
| `MaxPrice` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `float64` |          |
| `NoWait` (via `--cli-input-json` only)   | `bool`    |          |

```sh
greennode monitor quote-create-notification-quota --kind Email
```

## quote-create-synthetic-quota

Kind: Read.

Estimates one month of a selected free package after verifying quota absence and
eligibility in the class catalog. Uses class unit prices. Paid offers are
refused. MaxPrice and NoWait are ignored. Read-only permits this quote.

| Flag                                     | Type      | Required |
| ---------------------------------------- | --------- | -------- |
| `--class-id`                             | `string`  | yes      |
| `--package-id`                           | `string`  | yes      |
| `--quantity`                             | `int`     | yes      |
| `MaxPrice` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `float64` |          |
| `NoWait` (via `--cli-input-json` only)   | `bool`    |          |

```sh
greennode monitor quote-create-synthetic-quota --class-id <class-id> --package-id <package-id> --quantity <quantity>
```

## quote-renew-synthetic-quota

Kind: Read.

Estimates one month from the active quota and its identity-checked detail.
ExpectedEndTime must be RFC 3339 and match the quota expiry. MaxPrice,
MaxDaysLeft, and NoWait are ignored. Read-only permits this quote.

| Flag                                        | Type      | Required |
| ------------------------------------------- | --------- | -------- |
| `--expected-end-time`                       | `string`  | yes      |
| `MaxPrice` (via `--cli-input-json` only)    | `float64` |          |
| `MaxDaysLeft` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `int`     |          |
| `NoWait` (via `--cli-input-json` only)      | `bool`    |          |

```sh
greennode monitor quote-renew-synthetic-quota --expected-end-time <expected-end-time>
```
